_doc: Workflow card overlay for the Pulse /workflows page. Declares the card slots a job definition cannot carry: input, SOP, output, destination, and the real steps with their executor (code, model, judgment, agent or human). Keys are record ids from `bun LIFEOS/WORKFLOWS/Workflows.ts list`. Overlay values win over derived ones; the job definitions stay the source of truth for scheduling. Delete the example card and add one per workflow you want described. The file is optional: without it every card shows only what the inventory can derive.

agent-job:example-digest.purpose: <one sentence: what this workflow is for>
agent-job:example-digest.input: <what it reads, e.g. your inbox or a feed>
agent-job:example-digest.sop: <path to the skill or doc that defines how it runs>
agent-job:example-digest.destination: <where the output goes, e.g. a Pulse page or an email>
